reason: Establishes the immutable completion-bundle shape (work commit, archive, journal tail) that fixes where the acceptance-criteria tick may be written and why a fourth commit is unrecoverable.
Defines what the completion-mode receipt accepts as a bookkeeping path; the tick rides in the archive commit and must not invalidate the bundle.
Governs the documentation path-reference gate the new spec file and the skill edit must satisfy.
The refresh skill's PRD-authoring guidance is bound to the vendored-Trellis floor; tag-emitting guidance is added in that same stage.
